reproduction.trigger: Advance either wall or monotonic clock without executing scheduled timeout callbacks, then release SDK continuation. Old checkpoint accepts the late continuation.

coverage: Deadline checks at checkpoint and resolved SDK result with timer callbacks deliberately undispatched
Monotonic expiry despite a backwards wall clock; wall expiry while monotonic clock remains fixed
Late SDK rejections are classified by the expired preparation/confirmation deadline
Existing role journal persistence, deployment timeout and private operation-context behavior
limits: Tests control clock values and callback ordering; physical OS suspend/resume and native-wallet behavior are not claimed.
A forward wall-clock adjustment can expire the wait conservatively. No hard real-time guarantee when browser execution is suspended.
A post-checkpoint timeout remains an unknown transaction outcome, not proof of failure or safe retry.
No new E2E/full regression, runtime image refresh or public deployment.
